title: Annie Jacobson: hunt for the Horten brothers
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Annie Jacobson: hunt for the Horten brothers, about post-1945 at Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then Annie Jacobson writes about in her book Area 51 that there was this attempted, you know, they they really wanted to find the Horton brothers

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a book by the writer Annie Jacobson called Area 51, named after a secret US military base in Nevada. He says Jacobson writes that after 1945 there was a real effort to find the Horten brothers, two men in Germany whom the Americans very much wanted to track down. He tells it because, if true, it shows how keen the US was to get hold of certain German know-how after the war.
